summary: v3 lean-consult benchmark complete (n=5, opus, 10/10 solved, 0 contamination). HEADLINE: cost-weighted gross ON/OFF = 1.025× (PARITY) vs v2 fat consult's 1.63×. Lean compact payload (~1-3k vs ~25k) closed the overhead gap; consulting the graph is now cost-neutral. cost net ON/OFF = 0.35× (agent does ~65% less work with context). Arc: v1 unused=neutral → v2 fat=+63% → v3 lean=parity. Payload size WAS the overhead. Verdict note-mq70mq8w; bench/report-v3.{md,json}.
